description: This script seeds the development database with initial data including roles, users, questions, a template, and an assignment. It uses SQLAlchemy ORM models and includes functions to create or retrieve entities, ensuring idempotency.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user account with roles and personal details.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Defines different roles assigned to users, like admin, candidate, etc.

classes.name: Question
classes.description: Represents a question in the database, including multiple choice options.

classes.name: Option
classes.description: Different options for MCQ questions, indicating the correct answer.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: A test template that contains sections and questions.

classes.name: TemplateSection
classes.description: A section within a test template, specifying question type and quantity.

classes.name: TestAssignment
classes.description: Assignment of a test template to a candidate, including status and scheduling info.

methods.name: Role get_or_create_role(db: Session, name: str, description: str = "")
methods.description: Fetches an existing role by name or creates it if not found.

methods.name: User get_or_create_user(db: Session, email: str, password: str, full_name: str, role: Role)
methods.description: Fetches an existing user by email or creates it with specified role.

methods.name: list[Question] create_sample_questions(db: Session)
methods.description: Creates sample questions with options if they do not already exist.

methods.name: Template create_template(db: Session, name: str = "General Aptitude Test")
methods.description: Creates a test template with sections if it does not already exist.

methods.name: TestAssignment create_assignment(db: Session, candidate: User, template: Template)
methods.description: Creates a test assignment linking a candidate and a template.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main execution function to seed the database with initial data.

ctags.name: create_assignment
ctags.pattern: /^def create_assignment(db: Session, candidate: User, template: Template) -> TestAssignment:$/

ctags.name: create_template
ctags.pattern: /^def create_template(db: Session, name: str = "General Aptitude Test") -> Template:$/

ctags.name: get_or_create_role
ctags.pattern: /^def get_or_create_role(db: Session, name: str, description: str = "") -> Role:$/

ctags.name: get_or_create_user
ctags.pattern: /^def get_or_create_user(db: Session, email: str, password: str, full_name: str, role: Role) -> Us/
ctags.signature: (db: Session, email: str, password: str, full_name: str, role: Role)
